title: EXTRACTION SNAPSHOT STAMP
description: Successful extractions now end with a crisp dossier snapshot, stamped loot icons, squad poses, and a satisfying paper-thunk as the run summary lands on screen.
consequence: The escape gets a clean little click.

title: DEEPER NIGHT LIGHTING
description: Night scenes now use darker shadows, warmer campfire falloff, and less ambient blue fill so forests, caves, and abandoned cabins feel properly unlit.
consequence: The dark gets its job back. The screenshots lose their manners.

title: OVERSIZED CRIT BURSTS
description: Critical hits now trigger larger damage numbers, brighter hit sparks, and a brief camera punch so big shots read clearly in clips, trailers, and chaotic squad fights.
consequence: Every headshot arrives with stage directions.

title: REALISTIC MUD SEASON
description: Spring fields now build up sticky mud after rain, slowing footwork, dulling tool swings, and leaving the whole farm pleasantly authentic and slightly miserable.
